options.name: proactive_substrate_persistent
options.description: Phase 3 (M3.1 + M3.2) — Hardened substrate. Persistence (M3.1): every stateful component (Goals, Capabilities, World Model, Ledger, Vitals) reads from and writes to durable JSON/JSONL files via proactive.persistence. State directory defaults to app/storage/proactive/ (override with NUMEL_PROACTIVE_DIR). Middleware (M3.2): the three gates (Veracity, Privacy, Adversarial) call into proactive.middleware — heuristic confidence scoring with source trust + suspicion patterns, policy-driven PII/secret redaction, and prompt-injection detection over a typed untrusted_content envelope.

nodes.script:
# Substrate §3.3 — Goal Hierarchy (persistent).
# Loads goals.json on first access; lazy-seeds a default Standing Goal
# if the file is empty; writes back on any mutation.
import time
try:
    from proactive.persistence import read_json, write_json
except ImportError:
    import sys, os
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.getcwd(), 'app'))
    from proactive.persistence import read_json, write_json

env   = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
goals = variables.get("goals")
if goals is None:
    goals = read_json("goals", default={})
    variables["goals"] = goals

mutated = False
if "core.demo.standing" not in goals:
    goals["core.demo.standing"] = {
        "id":         "core.demo.standing",
        "tier":       "Standing Goal",
        "title":      "Stay aware of inbound signals and route them safely",
        "lifecycle":  "active",
        "created_at": time.time(),
    }
    mutated = True

if mutated:
    write_json("goals", goals)

active = [g["id"] for g in goals.values() if g.get("lifecycle") == "active"]
env["relevant_goals"] = active
env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({"stage": "goal_hierarchy", "matched": len(active)})
output = env

# Substrate §3.2 — World Model write (persistent).
# Loads world_model.json on first access; bumps the revision; writes back.
import time
try:
    from proactive.persistence import read_json, write_json
except ImportError:
    import sys, os
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.getcwd(), 'app'))
    from proactive.persistence import read_json, write_json

env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
wm  = variables.get("world_model")
if wm is None:
    wm = read_json("world_model", default={})
    variables["world_model"] = wm

path = "core.inbox.last_envelope"
prev = wm.get(path) or {}
rev  = int(prev.get("revision", 0)) + 1
wm[path] = {
    "value":      env.get("untrusted_content"),
    "confidence": env.get("confidence"),
    "source":     "core.middleware",
    "revision":   rev,
    "ts":         time.time(),
}
write_json("world_model", wm)
env["world_model_write"] = {"path": path, "revision": rev}
output = env

# Substrate §6.1 — Ledger append (persistent).
# Append-only JSONL file. Caches the current count in variables to
# avoid re-reading the whole file every tick.
import time
try:
    from proactive.persistence import append_jsonl, read_jsonl
except ImportError:
    import sys, os
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.getcwd(), 'app'))
    from proactive.persistence import append_jsonl, read_jsonl

env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}

count = variables.get("ledger_count")
if count is None:
    count = len(read_jsonl("ledger"))
variables["ledger_count"] = count = count + 1

entry = {
    "id":                  f"led_{count}",
    "ts":                  time.time(),
    "correlation_id":      env.get("correlation_id"),
    "trigger":             {"topic": "core.middleware.input_received"},
    "provenance":          env.get("provenance", []),
    "relevant_goals":      env.get("relevant_goals", []),
    "resolved_capability": env.get("resolved_capability"),
    "world_model_write":   env.get("world_model_write"),
    "governor_verdict":    env.get("governor_verdict"),
    "expected_outcome":    "substrate_pass_through",
    "actual_outcome":      "recorded",
}
append_jsonl("ledger", entry)
output = entry

# Substrate §3.6 — Vitals (persistent).
# Reads the durable Ledger JSONL on every sweep so metrics survive
# across workflow runs. Real impl should incrementally update rather
# than re-scanning each time.
import time
try:
    from proactive.persistence import read_jsonl
except ImportError:
    import sys, os
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.getcwd(), 'app'))
    from proactive.persistence import read_jsonl

ledger = read_jsonl("ledger")

decisions = {}
latencies = []
for entry in ledger:
    d = (entry.get("governor_verdict") or {}).get("decision", "unknown")
    decisions[d] = decisions.get(d, 0) + 1
    prov     = entry.get("provenance") or []
    ts_first = next((p.get("ts") for p in prov if "ts" in p), None)
    if ts_first and entry.get("ts"):
        latencies.append(entry["ts"] - ts_first)

vitals = {
    "updated_at":             time.time(),
    "ledger_count":           len(ledger),
    "governor_decisions":     decisions,
    "avg_pipeline_latency_s": (sum(latencies) / len(latencies)) if latencies else 0.0,
}
variables["vitals"] = vitals
output = {"ledger_entry": input, "vitals": vitals}
